{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "build",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Labeled 'Build system' and 'Windows', modifies CMake build configurations and CI workflows to switch native Windows compilation from MSVC to clang-cl.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.7,
      "reason_tag": "platform fix",
      "rationale": "Switches native Windows builds to clang-cl and retires cl.exe support, resolving recurring compiler-specific maintenance burdens and yielding substantial build and runtime performance gains. Author's benchmarks show CI build times dropping from 20m 35s to 12m 43s and block connection throughput improving by over 50%, while closing compiler bug tracking issues #31456 and #36153."
    },
    {
      "name": "docs",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Documentation updates to Windows build guides and release notes are direct follow-through for the build system change.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Documentation changes purely document the compiler transition."
    },
    {
      "name": "kernel",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes to src/kernel/CMakeLists.txt are mechanical build flag adjustments.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not affect the libbitcoinkernel API, boundary, or validation logic."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "No P2P files or protocols are touched or affected.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not touch P2P networking."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Minor removal of MSVC workaround in util_not_null_tests.cpp is incidental to the compiler deprecation.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not alter test harnesses, frameworks, runners, or test capabilities."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Modifications to vendored build scripts (crc32c.cmake, leveldb.cmake, minisketch.cmake) and compat/byteswap.h are mechanical accommodations for the clang-cl compiler switch.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not modify core utility behavior, libraries, or subtrees on their own merits."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 1,
    "bug_severity": 0,
    "performance": 2,
    "user_value": 1,
    "leverage": 2
  }
}
